profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. According to its website, it describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle (AAV) technology platform company and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. The company says it provides AAV products and commercial solutions across urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions. Its site lists product and service areas covering passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions.

The site presents EHang as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global Urban Air Mobility industry, and describes its work as exploring the boundaries of the sky to benefit life in smart cities. The site also includes sections for company news, media coverage, a video center, partners, investor relations, and subscriptions to company updates.

The company's profile lists a CIK of 0001759783, which indicates registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. No litigation, no MCP servers, and no tracked products appear in the available records.
